title: MeetMind
description: An AI-powered application that automatically extracts tasks from meeting audio recordings, assigns them to team members using intelligent skill matching, and manages deadlines, priorities, and task dependencies — transforming meeting chaos into actionable workflows.

detail.problem: In today's fast-paced business environment, 70% of meeting decisions are never implemented due to poor follow-up, costing $37 billion annually on unproductive meetings in the US alone. Teams spend hours manually transcribing meetings and identifying action items, tasks are assigned inefficiently or forgotten entirely, and complex projects suffer from unrecognized task interdependencies. The average employee spends 31 hours per month in meetings, with significant time lost to manual note-taking and task assignment.

features.title: Intelligent Audio Processing
features.description: Upload meeting audio files (.mp3, .wav, .m4a) and get automatic transcription using OpenAI Whisper, with audio preprocessing including normalization and format conversion via FFmpeg.

features.title: Smart Task Extraction
features.description: Context-aware NLP pipeline that identifies actionable items from natural conversation, extracts deadlines from temporal expressions, detects priorities (Critical/High/Medium/Low), and handles vague references using surrounding context.

features.title: Automatic Team Assignment
features.description: Multi-factor assignment algorithm that matches tasks to team members through explicit mention detection, skill-based matching, role matching, and workload balancing — with confidence scores and assignment reasoning.

features.title: Dependency Mapping
features.description: Identifies task dependencies ('depends on', 'after', 'first'), builds directed dependency graphs using NetworkX, detects cycles, and provides execution order for project planning.

architecture.description: MeetMind follows a layered processing pipeline: Audio Upload → Preprocessing → Whisper Transcription → Text Processing → Task Extraction → Enrichment (Entity Recognition, Deadlines, Priorities, Dependencies) → Skill Matching → Task Assignment → Validation. The FastAPI backend handles the complete NLP pipeline, while a Vanilla JavaScript frontend provides a modern, responsive dashboard with dual card/table view modes.

techDetails.name: FastAPI
techDetails.role: High-performance async Python backend with REST API endpoints for audio processing, team management, and task validation

techDetails.name: OpenAI Whisper
techDetails.role: State-of-the-art speech-to-text transcription — handles multiple audio formats with high accuracy

techDetails.name: NLP Pipeline
techDetails.role: Custom NLP services: task extraction, NER, deadline parsing, priority detection, and skill inference — built without heavy ML frameworks

techDetails.name: NetworkX
techDetails.role: Directed graph library for building task dependency maps, cycle detection, and topological ordering

techDetails.name: Vanilla JavaScript
techDetails.role: Zero-dependency frontend with drag-and-drop uploads, real-time processing status, filterable card/table views, and dependency graph visualization via Chart.js

results.description: MeetMind transforms meeting chaos into organized, assigned task lists in seconds. The multi-factor assignment algorithm matches tasks with confidence scores and transparent reasoning. Dual view modes (cards and tables) with priority filters make it easy for teams to track and manage their workload.

highlights.title: Competitive Edge
highlights.text: Unlike Otter.ai (transcription-only) or Fireflies.ai (basic tasks), MeetMind provides end-to-end automation: audio → transcription → task extraction → intelligent assignment with dependency mapping.

title: Device Monitoring System
description: A comprehensive platform enabling IT administrators to remotely track, analyze, and secure computing devices in real-time with integrated security scanning.

detail.problem: Critical need for proactive IT infrastructure management. Organizations face challenges in tracking system health, detecting security threats in real-time, and managing distributed device fleets efficiently without high overhead.

features.title: Real-time Health Monitoring
features.description: Continuous tracking of CPU, RAM, disk usage, and battery status across all registered devices.

features.title: Security Threat Detection
features.description: Automated malware scanning of running processes using industry-leading VirusTotal integration.

features.title: Location-Aware Monitoring
features.description: Geographic tracking of device locations and ISP detection for asset management and security.

features.title: Alerting System
features.description: Configurable KPI thresholds with real-time notifications for critical system resource fluctuations.

architecture.description: Distributed client-server architecture using a reactive Vert.x framework. The MyAgent (Client) collects system metrics using OSHI, while the HttpServer (Backend) handles data aggregation, authentication, and serves the dashboard.

techDetails.name: Java & Vert.x
techDetails.role: Reactive, non-blocking framework for high-concurrency event-driven processing on both server and agent

techDetails.name: PostgreSQL
techDetails.role: Robust persistent storage for historical metrics, alerts, and user authentication data

techDetails.name: OSHI (System Info)
techDetails.role: Cross-platform hardware and software detection for comprehensive system metrics

techDetails.name: VirusTotal API
techDetails.role: Integrated security scanning for running processes to detect potential malware threats

techDetails.name: REST APIs
techDetails.role: Secure communication layer with BCrypt hashing and cookie-based session management

title: DocMind AI
description: A production-ready RAG system designed to bridge the gap between massive PDF data and actionable insights with source-verifiable transparency.

detail.problem: In a world where 80% of enterprise data is unstructured, employees spend an average of 1.8 hours every day—9.3 hours per week—searching and gathering information. Traditional AI assistants often suffer from 'hallucinations,' making them unreliable for business-critical tasks. DocMind bridges this gap by providing a production-ready RAG system that transforms static PDFs into intelligent knowledge bases, ensuring every answer is grounded in the uploaded data with exact page-level references for complete auditability and trust.

features.title: Smart Document Lifecycle
features.description: Automated ingestion pipeline that handles PDF parsing, intelligent text chunking with overlap to preserve context, and seamless indexing into a high-dimensional vector space.

features.title: Context-Aware Q&A
features.description: Advanced semantic search engine that goes beyond keyword matching to understand user intent, retrieving relevant document fragments to generate accurate, context-injected responses.

features.title: Source Pinpointing
features.description: Automatic extraction of page-level metadata during indexing, allowing the system to cite the specific file name and exact page number for every piece of information provided.

features.title: Near-Instant Latency
features.description: Engineered for high performance using the Groq LPU™ inference engine, delivering a fluid, real-time user experience with Llama 3 reasoning speeds that feel instantaneous.

architecture.description: DocMind utilizes a clean, modular RAG architecture designed for scalability and reliability. The pipeline consists of an Ingestion Layer (FastAPI + LangChain) for document processing, a Vector Intelligence Layer (Supabase Vector) for similarity search, and an Augmented Generation Layer (Groq + Llama 3) for high-speed reasoning. This serverless-ready architecture minimizes infrastructure overhead while maintaining high fidelity through Google Gemini embeddings.

techDetails.name: FastAPI (Python)
techDetails.role: High-concurrency, asynchronous API layer orchestrating the complete document lifecycle and RAG workflows

techDetails.name: LangChain & LangGraph
techDetails.role: Sophisticated framework for document parsing, intelligent chunking, and managing complex AI agent logic

techDetails.name: Supabase Vector (pgvector)
techDetails.role: Enterprise-grade vector database providing persistent, high-dimensional similarity search and secure metadata storage

techDetails.name: Google Gemini API
techDetails.role: Utilized for generating high-fidelity vector embeddings (gemini-embedding-2) to ensure precise semantic indexing

techDetails.name: Groq LPU™
techDetails.role: State-of-the-art inference engine powering Llama 3.3 70B for near-instant, high-fidelity response generation

results.description: DocMind drastically reduces information retrieval time by automating the search process within large document sets. By grounding LLM responses in specific document context, it eliminates hallucinations and provides verifiable transparency through automatic source attribution.
